gold.user: User wants to retrieve the list of all navigation views available in the Zulip application to understand the current layout and options.
gold.ideal: The response should include a JSON array of navigation views with their respective identifiers and properties.

gold.user: User wants to create a new navigation view to enhance their workflow by adding quick access to specific channels.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful creation of the navigation view and return the details of the newly created view.

gold.user: User wants to update an existing navigation view to change its name or the channels it links to, improving usability.
gold.ideal: The response should indicate that the navigation view has been successfully updated and return the updated details.

gold.user: User wants to remove a navigation view that is no longer needed, to declutter their navigation options.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful deletion of the navigation view and ensure it is no longer accessible.
